name: Magnus Hovland
bio:
Magnus Hovland's motorsport journey began in the frigid karting circuits of Norway, where his meticulous approach to vehicle setup quickly garnered attention. After a brief stint as a driver himself, he transitioned into team management, recognizing his strengths lay in optimizing performance through strategic oversight and driver development. His philosophy centers around fostering a collaborative environment, empowering team members, and rigorously analyzing data to gain a competitive edge. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to extract the best from both drivers and engineers.

Hovland joined Sodi Kart Factory five years ago as a junior engineer. His climb to Team Principal has been meteoric. He is renowned for his analytical skills and his ability to find marginal gains. He believes a strong team culture is the key to success, and fosters a family atmosphere amongst his staff, which has led to increased performance and loyalty.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: A tall, lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Drinks precisely two cups of strong black coffee before each race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
